svg.title: My Stack — in motion
svg.desc: 32 original technology icons rotate through a three-dimensional cloud around an iqwqi signature. Adaptive light and dark palettes, softly tinted glass frames and pink, lavender and pale blue accents. Rust, Go, Zig, Bash, C, C++, Kotlin, Python, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, Astro, React, Vue, Tailwind CSS, Vite, Three.js, Node.js, Gradle, Android Studio, PyTorch, OpenCV, Git, Docker, Kubernetes, Prometheus, Grafana, PostgreSQL, SQLite, MySQL, Redis. Original logo artwork from Skill Icons, copyright 2022 tandpfun, MIT license in assets/icons/LICENSE.
